## Open-Source Implementations

The GPSD project ships an AIVDM/AIVDO sentence decoder as part of the daemon. This document was developed to be the specification for it, and it will decode all sentence type described herein.

The source-code repository of the GPSD project holds a conforming standalone Python decoder, ais.py, that is not included in shipped releases. It may be useful for developers working in that language.

[\[Schwehr\]](https://gpsd.io/AIVDM.html#Schwehr) includes links to a collection of Python scripts for decoding and analyzing AIVDM sentences. Kurt Schwehr warns that this is research code rather than a production tool.

There is a [GNU AIS](http://gnuais.sourceforge.net/) project at SourceForge. It seems intended primarily to work directly with AIS radios.

[The Maritec decoder](http://www.maritec.co.za/aisvdmvdodecoding) looks to be pretty high-quality and can be exercised through a public web form. This is a useful resource for anyone qualifying an AIS decoder.
